title: EXP-003 — Paint a little heart, light it, and bring it back.
goal: A known heart (the documented Heart replay) takes real lighting as one undoable step: Apply changes colors but not the silhouette, Undo returns the exact heart, Redo returns the exact lit heart, and a second Undo returns the heart again.
cliOnly: painting the heart through thirteen real Pen drags
decoded PNG and all 1,024 channels of the lit and restored rasters

steps.why: Lighting changed colors while every pixel stays painted.
Redo restores the exact lit heart.
A second Undo returns the exact heart again.
